description: Creates a standalone text node bound to a DS text style (textStyleId — accepts style name or key) and DS color variable (fillVariable) — both are mandatory when the DS has them. Use for text OUTSIDE components; text inside a component instance uses figma_component_text instead. Strips hardcoded line breaks (container width controls wrapping). Name nodes after their HTML role ("Page Title", "Card: Revenue Label"). Params: parentId + content required. Phase 2+.

fillStyleId.description: DS fill style key for text color (from figma_list_ds (kind: "fill_styles")). Preferred over fillVariable when DS has fill styles but no variables.

fillVariable.description: DS variable path for text color.

fontSizeVariable.description: DS variable path for font size (if no text style).

layoutPositioning.description: Set to ABSOLUTE to overlay this text inside an auto-layout parent.

lineHeightVariable.description: DS variable path for line height.

name.description: Semantic name describing the HTML element role (e.g., "Page Title", "Card: Revenue Label", "Subtitle"). Never use generic names like "Text".

textStyleId.description: DS text style — accepts style name (e.g. "Text sm/Semibold") or style key. Names are resolved to keys automatically.

width.description: Fixed width for the text node.

name: figma_create_text
